game.title: Kansas City Chiefs at Seattle Seahawks

lede: Kansas City Chiefs carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#10 in EPA per play), while Seattle Seahawks owns the more favourable defensive matchup (#2 in EPA allowed per play).
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Seattle Seahawks −6.0 with a fair total of 42.5 — inside a touchdown, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is Kansas City Chiefs pass offence vs Seattle Seahawks pass defence, which sits −0.184 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
The largest uncertainty is availability: NFL injury report — not loaded in this session.
